task_blueprints.title: Survey prior datasets, benchmarks, and data cards
task_blueprints.description: Collect the main related datasets and benchmark suites, then compare scope and governance tradeoffs.

task_blueprints.title: Synthesize dataset gaps and positioning
task_blueprints.description: Explain which data coverage, quality, or evaluation gaps remain unsolved and how this project positions itself.

quality_gate: Dataset scope, target users, and use restrictions are explicit
Value over existing datasets is articulated

task_blueprints.title: Define dataset problem statement and scope boundaries
task_blueprints.description: Specify target use-cases, inclusion/exclusion scope, and risk boundaries.

task_blueprints.title: Design schema and data collection plan
task_blueprints.description: Define label schema, sampling strategy, and collection channels.

quality_gate: Benchmark and baseline plan are executable

task_blueprints.title: Specify annotation, cleaning, and quality-control protocol
task_blueprints.description: Define annotation guidelines, inter-annotator checks, and curation flow.

task_blueprints.title: Run baseline benchmark plan and error analysis
task_blueprints.description: Establish baseline models/heuristics, evaluate, and summarize failure patterns.

quality_gate: Data card and governance statements are complete
Release artifacts and benchmark tables are publication-ready

task_blueprints.title: Prepare dataset documentation and data card
task_blueprints.description: Draft dataset statement, bias/safety notes, and intended-use guidance.

task_blueprints.title: Finalize release bundle and submission package
task_blueprints.description: Assemble benchmark tables, README/license, and supplementary artifacts.

quality_gate: Slides and homepage highlight dataset value, access path, and benchmark evidence
Delivery plan covers downloads, walkthrough assets, and public-facing explanations

task_blueprints.title: Create dataset overview story for slides and homepage
task_blueprints.description: Package the dataset motivation, coverage, and benchmark value into a public-facing narrative.

task_blueprints.title: Generate showcase visuals and supporting media assets
task_blueprints.description: Prepare examples, summary figures, and homepage visuals for dataset promotion.

task_blueprints.title: Assemble narration, slide, and homepage delivery bundle
task_blueprints.description: Produce narration guidance and package assets for talks, demos, and dataset release communication.
